en.bdb: Praises of Waheguru, the wondrous Lord

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਅਚਰਜ ਅਚਰਜ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਰਜ ਹੈਰਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh acharaj acharaj hoi acharaj hairaanaa|

en.bdb: Beholding the wondrous Lord myriad’s of wonders become full of wonder.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: visam hoi visamaadh lakh lakh choj viddaanaa|

en.bdb: Seeing his wonderful deeds, the elation itself becomes elated.
Realising his marvellous Order many uncanny arrangements feel themselves full of wonder.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਬਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: abigat gat agaadh bodh apara(n)par baanaa|

en.bdb: His unmanifest position is unknowable and His form and guise is formless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਜਪਾ ਜਪਣੁ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: akath kathaa ajapaa japan net net vakhaanaa|

en.bdb: His tale is ineffable; unrecited recitations are performed for Him but even He is described as neti neti(not this not that).

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes hai kudharat kurabaanaa ||24||

en.bdb: I salute that primal Lord and I am sacrifice unto His feats.
